title: Four questions before release.
intro: A cyclist chooses the Route 800 from the light comparison and orders one. What do you need to know before the comparison feature goes live?

code-review-and-quality.label: Code quality
code-review-and-quality.question: Does each button add the chosen model to the basket and carry it through to the confirmation?

accessibility-engineering.label: Accessibility
accessibility-engineering.question: Can a visitor using a screen reader tell which light each price and order button belongs to?

security-and-hardening.label: Security
security-and-hardening.question: Does checkout use the current catalog price to calculate the order total?

performance-optimization.label: Performance
performance-optimization.question: How quickly can someone read the comparison on a phone with a slow connection?
